notes.title: This game is going to be removed from the Steam Store.
notes.notes:
Hi there,

I regret to inform you that Prime Shift will be removed from Steam.

The game is online only, and since it unfortunately failed to garner a community, the online servers have been very quiet.  Eventually this forced me to shut down these servers, hosted by Photon, as it made no sense in keeping the subscription to Photon going.

Thank you all for your support and interest in the game.

Kind Regards,
David

notes.title: A few days later, what's changed.
notes.notes:
So apart from the upcoming move from Paid to Free(with Paid DLC), some changes will take effect soon.


All the major bugs have been fixed and the game is running without interruption now.


I'm also introducing Badges.

Badges are icons that are displayed to an opponent when facing them in battle.  It's displayed next to the username.

Badges can be bought with RP, you will also start with 3 free badges.

So if you've bought the game and receive the DLC to unlock all Primes, you'll still have something to spend hard-earned RP on.  :D

Badges will go live in the next 24 hours.

notes.title: Going from Paid to Free in a week!
notes.notes:
Hey,

So Prime Shift is changing from Paid to Free in a week.


The reason for the change is to get more players onto the server.

Players who bought the game will receive a DLC that will unlock all Primes permanently.

This DLC will also be available for purchase by any free or new player for the same price as the original release price($4.99).


Thank you for your patients and understanding,
David Mulder
Red Splat Games
